headline: Tony Brown, Host of Public Affairs Show Aimed at Black Audiences, Dies at 93
context: On “Tony Brown’s Journal,” he interviewed guests like Jesse Jackson and Lena Horne, and made programming decisions by asking himself, “Will it help Black people?”
